original_ai_output.title_zh: 肯尼亚首例埃博拉病例相关十人被隔离，筛查担忧加剧
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 肯尼亚卫生官员称，与一名死于埃博拉的男子有过接触的十人已被隔离，当局正试图追踪另外57名接触者。该患者从刚果（金）出发，途经乌干达，最终飞抵内罗毕，其间病情未被发现。非洲疾控中心负责人对筛查措施提出质疑，肯尼亚当局则呼吁民众不要恐慌。

location.raw_text: Nairobi, Kenya; patient travelled from Buta, DR Congo via Kisangani, Beni, Uganda

key_facts.fact: 与肯尼亚首例埃博拉死亡病例接触的十人被隔离
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ten people who came into contact with a man who died of Ebola in Kenya have been quarantined, health officials in the East African nation say.

key_facts.fact: 当局正试图追踪另外57名接触者
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: They are also trying to trace 57 other contacts of the Kenyan patient after he travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo, dying in hospital in Nairobi on Monday.

key_facts.fact: 该患者从刚果（金）出发，途经乌干达，最终飞抵内罗毕，其间病情未被发现
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the patient passed through multiple cities in DR Congo, driving to Uganda and eventually flying to Kenya without his sickness being detected

key_facts.fact: 非洲疾控中心负责人对筛查措施提出质疑
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: What are symptoms he was presenting? Why was he not detected? he asked.

key_facts.fact: 肯尼亚当局呼吁民众不要恐慌，并加强机场和边境口岸监测
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Kenyan authorities have urged people not to panic, with the health ministry assuring of heightened surveillance at airports and border crossings.

key_facts.fact: 今年刚果（金）已有超过4000人死于埃博拉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: More than 4,000 people have died from Ebola in DR Congo this year, in what is the second most deadly known outbreak of the disease.

uncertainties: 患者是否因服药掩盖症状而通过筛查，仅为肯尼亚卫生部官员的说法，尚未证实
非洲疾控中心正在调查该病例，调查结果尚未公布
肯尼亚医生工会代表称边境存在疏漏，属其个人观察，未获官方确认
